changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwencounterplans AS SELECT ep.id, ep.patient_id, ep.encounter_id, ep.goals, ep.treatment_plan, ep.created_date, ep.created_by, ep.last_modified_by, ep.last_modified_date FROM public.encounter_plans ep;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwencounterplans TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwencounterplans FROM report_user;
